master_measurement.authority: Untouched original M, measured directly from master-M.png, not from a generated letter.
master_measurement.measurement_method: Main ribbon: first separated white interval at native rows 70, 87, 104, 122, 139, 153; normal width = horizontal interval length / sqrt(1 + centerline_slope squared). Return: middle interval at rows 70–95 with its own fitted centerline. Local radii: least-squares circle fits to threshold outline samples in recorded windows; approximate curvature, not literal circular construction.
